direction: Five new playful trust and security mascots. Warm yellow, red and cream dominate. Blue is a tiny accent only.

concepts.name: Finn
concepts.description: A cheerful payroll nerd with a checked folder held close. Human warmth, careful work, and a reassuring wave.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a BRAND NEW original mascot concept for a payroll AI chat assistant. It must immediately communicate TRUST, SECURITY, and approachable competence while remaining FUN, warm, and charming. One single static 2D sprite, one full-body idle pose, no background, true alpha transparency, square canvas. Cohesive premium cartoon illustration: bold smooth charcoal contours, simple broad shapes, restrained cel shading, expressive intelligent eyes, compact readable silhouette at 64 pixels. Rounded proportions, charming confident smile; professional helper for adults, not a baby. Palette hierarchy is crucial: warm near-white/cream and SD Worx golden yellow #FFBE00 dominate, vivid SD Worx red #F1002F is the main contrasting brand color, charcoal #212223 for glasses/outlines/details. SD Worx blue #006DD8 must be a TINY detail only, at most 3 percent of visible character area. No blue body, no blue clothes, no blue outlines, no blue shadows, no purple or lavender. Preserve natural skin/hair colors when applicable. Center all of the character with 10% safe transparent margins, no cropped parts. Security should feel friendly and reassuring, not militaristic. No weapons, armor, police badge, ominous cyber imagery, busy effects, background scene, ground shadow, typography, wordmark, or watermark. Do not write the words trust or security; communicate through the character design. Only the character and its described attached/held prop. Exactly one image, not a sheet.
Subject: A new nerdy adult male payroll consultant mascot called Finn: warm medium skin, wavy dark-brown quiff with one funny cowlick, oversized ROUND CHARCOAL glasses, calm clever eyes, reassuring crooked smile. Compact full body with a large head, short sturdy legs. RED #F1002F cardigan over warm ivory shirt, charcoal trousers, cream sneakers with golden yellow soles. He cradles a large GOLDEN YELLOW payroll folder against his chest; on its front a simple cream shield containing a bold charcoal checkmark, clear and readable. One hand gives a gentle open-palm welcoming wave. His tiny BLUE collar pin is the only blue anywhere. Friendly accountable expert, fun and dependable, no necktie.

Subject: An anthropomorphic friendly SHIELD called Vera. Main body a compact rounded heraldic shield, broad shoulders and gentle rounded point at base, ivory face area, thick GOLDEN YELLOW #FFBE00 outer rim. The upper part of the shield has a friendly expressive face with thick charcoal half-round nerdy spectacles, raised kind eyebrows, warm smile. The lower central body has ONE bold red #F1002F checkmark, separate from the face. Short ivory cartoon arms and tiny charcoal feet; one hand resting on hip, one gives a small friendly wave. A jaunty small RED bow tie integrated just below the face. One TINY BLUE rivet on the golden rim is the only blue detail. Strong shield silhouette; no separate head and no human torso, no armor.

Subject: A new charming owl mascot named Scout, a watchful nerdy payroll guardian. Plump compact GOLDEN YELLOW #FFBE00 body and wings, large warm ivory face disks and chest, big charcoal eyes behind thick charcoal round spectacles. Two playful feather tufts like neatly combed eyebrows, tiny coral-red beak, little charcoal feet. Wearing a simple RED #F1002F short waistcoat open at the chest.
